mapper.sql: select id, family_id, host_id, start_time, end_time, live_time_sec, ticket, times from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day
mapper.insert:
insert into ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day
family_id, host_id, start_time, end_time, live_time_sec, ticket, times,
#{familyId}, #{hostId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{liveTimeSec}, #{ticket}, #{times},
mapper.update:
update ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day
family_id = #{familyId},
host_id = #{hostId},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
live_time_sec = #{liveTimeSec},
ticket = #{ticket},
times = #{times},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day l where l.host_id=#{userId} ORDER BY start_time desc LIMIT 1

select o.family_id familyId, f.name familyName, f.user_id familyUserId, f.nick_name familyNickName, o.host_id hostId, u.nick_name nickName, SUM(o.live_time_sec) as alltime, sum(o.ticket) as allticket, SUBSTR(o.start_time,1,10) as shijian, #{countTime} timedata from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day o left join ${dbLive}.live_family f on o.family_id=f.id left join ${dbLive}.live_user u on o.host_id=u.id where o.live_time_sec > 0 and o.id like '${dto.dateDay}%' and o.family_id = #{dto.familyId} and o.host_id = #{dto.hostId} and u.nick_name like concat('%',#{dto.nickName},'%') and o.start_time >= #{dto.startTime} and o.end_time <= #{dto.endTime} group by o.host_id order by o.start_time desc
